why_next: The frozen FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict closes the entropy-rate CMI pathway on the stochastic 12-state SPA: the per-stratum KL bias is NOT estimator-specific — entropy-rate CMI exhibits the same irreconcilable tradeoff as plug-in KL. The root cause is Laplace smoothing on discrete spaces with many cells (the (z,a) space has n_a times more cells than the z-only space, and pseudo-counts add artificial uncertainty proportional to cell count). The CMI estimation program on discrete SPAs with Laplace smoothing is now exhausted across plug-in KL (parent, alpha sweep), entropy-rate (this experiment), KSG CMI k=5 (parent, insensitive), and LR chi2 (parent, history collapse). The next orthogonal attack vectors are estimators that do NOT use histogram smoothing: Bayesian model comparison (nested model Bayes factor), likelihood-ratio tests, or continuous-state estimators (KDE, kNN with bias correction, neural density estimators). If all discrete CMI estimators fail, the Physics lane must pivot to production Web data with continuous state representations.

established: True I(Y;A|Z) = 1.52 bits on stochastic 12-state SPA (audit-confirmed, parent chain)
Plug-in KL alpha sweep tradeoff is monotonic and irreconcilable on this SPA at N=5000: alpha=0 K3=1.377 but |null|=0.924; alpha=1.0 |null|=0.064 but K3=0.099. No crossover. (EXP-PHYSICS-35530591329)

Entropy-rate CMI does NOT bypass the per-stratum KL bias: ALL alphas (0.1, 0.5, 1.0) fail C1 (|null_mean| >= 0.1 bits: 0.240, 0.200, 0.275). The bias is intrinsic to Laplace smoothing, not the KL divergence formulation. (EXP-PHYSICS-35538866166)

Laplace smoothing inflates H(Y|Z,A) more than H(Y|Z) because the (z,a) conditioning space has n_a times more cells. At alpha>=0.5, this produces negative CMI values (artifacts). Deterministic SPA construct validation also fails at alpha>=0.5. (EXP-PHYSICS-35538866166 audit V1, V3)
Corrected P(z) denominator (audit V1) yields small positive CMI (0.12/0.05 at alpha 0.5/1.0) but still fails C3 (<0.5 bits). The FALSIFIED verdict is robust to this implementation bug.
KSG CMI k=5 is k-invariant but insensitive (K3=0.000560). LR chi2 collapses history (K2=K3 exactly). Both closed on this SPA class. (EXP-PHYSICS-35482477045, EXP-PHYSICS-35476270440)
Design verification: 48/48 (state,action) pairs with 4 distinct candidates, 2 non-empty stratum size buckets. (EXP-PHYSICS-35538866166)
Null centering at alpha=1.0 for plug-in KL is robust (|mean|=0.064), but this specific estimator property does not transfer to entropy-rate CMI.

do_not_assume: This FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict closes C-WEB-DYNAMICS or the Physics lane. It closes only the entropy-rate CMI pathway on this specific SPA class. Alternative estimators and non-smoothed approaches remain untested.
CMI estimation is fundamentally impossible on discrete SPAs. MLE alpha=0 recovers K3=1.377 bits; per-stratum PMI 1.46-1.69 bits. The signal IS detectable; the failure is Laplace-smoothing-specific.
The 1.52-bit true CMI is undetectable. The signal is strong and confirmed by multiple independent measurements.
Production Web transitions generalize from this synthetic 12-state SPA. SPA has hash routing, 4 candidates per (state,action), no anti-bot, auth, visual complexity, or production stochasticity.
The consistent K3-K2 differences (0.08-0.19 bits) are evidence for or against beyond-Markov dynamics. They may be residual smoothing asymmetry between K2 (n_z=1438) and K3 (n_z=841) cell counts.

Entropy-rate CMI is worse than plug-in KL at all smoothing levels. At alpha=1.0 plug-in KL passes C1 (|null|=0.064) while entropy-rate fails (|null|=0.275), but this is alpha-specific not estimator-class-specific.

recommended_action: Design a new frozen experiment testing Bayesian model comparison (action-dependent vs action-independent transition model via Bayes factor with nested model comparison) on the stochastic 12-state SPA at N=5000. This estimator does NOT use histogram smoothing — it computes marginal likelihoods over model parameters, completely bypassing the Laplace cell-count bias that felled both plug-in KL and entropy-rate CMI. The frozen experiment must include: (a) the same C1 within-session shuffled-action null framework (500 permutations), (b) a C3 positive control on the deterministic SPA where the Bayes factor should strongly favor the action-dependent model, (c) the same C6/C7 design verification, and (d) comparison with the established per-stratum PMI signal (1.46-1.69 bits) as a reference scale. If Bayesian comparison passes C1+C3, proceed to beyond-Markov K3-K2 testing. If it also fails, pivot to non-smoothed continuous estimators (KDE/kNN on embeddings) or production Web data with continuous state representations. The Physics lane has now exhausted 4 discrete CMI estimator families (plug-in KL, entropy-rate, KSG, LR); the next experiment must use a fundamentally different estimation paradigm.
